Strict content security policy

This page forbids inline styles, inline scripts and fonts from other origins. The extension must still be able to change fonts, draw its overlay and open the reader view.

Readers with ADHD benefit from a calm page. A second paragraph gives the reader view enough text to work with, and a third one makes the article long enough to count as an article.

Browsers apply the page's policy to the page's own resources; extension resources and constructable stylesheets are handled separately, which is what this test checks.
